So far, 'Chain of Thought' has allowed us a glimpse at the processes by which Large Language Models work their way through problems. What if these LLMs begin to talk in a language only they understand?

Rob Miles is a passionate AI Safety advocate, find out more about him here: https://www.youtube.com/c/robertmilesai 

Computerphile is supported by Jane Street. Learn more about them (and exciting career opportunities) at: https://jane-st.co/computerphile

This video was filmed and edited by Sean Riley.

Computerphile is a sister project to Brady Haran's Numberphile. More at https://www.bradyharanblog.com

snippet.description:
Once an aspirant. Now, a Rank-maker.

From preparing for the UPSC himself to mentoring and creating successful UPSC rankers, Karandeep Singh Sir’s journey is a story of persistence, setbacks, learning and ultimately, helping others succeed.

After UPSC Mains 2026, aspirants shared remarkable feedback on their preparation — with many saying that questions from their notes, classes and test series appeared in the Anthropology paper. Some even said, “Sir, paper aapne hi banaya tha.”

A story that goes beyond one subject — and resonates with every UPSC aspirant chasing their dream of becoming an IAS officer.
